baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus sequence at words 2, 4, 6, and 7 joins human formation, outward dispersal, creaturely movement, and signs.
baseline_models.mechanism: Measured and completed form supplies local order, while scattering and ground-level movement supply spatial plurality; visible marks allow one ordering process to be recognized across stationary form and moving life.

activation_trace.role: Estimation and proportion make human formation an ordered measure rather than bare existence.
Completed and balanced form makes bodily configuration an inspectable component of the sign.
Scattering and spreading supply the outward distribution that connects many local forms.
Light or slow movement on the ground gives the distributed field observable creaturely motion.
A manifest mark converts proportion and motion from facts into legible evidence.
Knowledge fixed after doubt supplies the epistemic endpoint of comparing the patterns.

changed_reading.before: Human creation and animals are two examples of divine signs.
changed_reading.after: Measured bodies and spatially dispersed motions form one patterned field whose cross-scale coherence can settle doubt.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 2, 4, 6, and 7 can be read as an inward-to-outward sequence rather than only a list of visible objects.
baseline_models.mechanism: Inward disposition and imperceptible circulation are initially concealed; broadcasting or disclosing brings their effects outward, where a visible mark makes the hidden process inferable.

activation_trace.role: Inward nature or disposition supplies a concealed layer within human formation.
Disclosure of what is held inside supplies the transition from latent condition to outward evidence.
Hidden circulation that escapes immediate sensation gives the creature term an imperceptible dynamic layer.
The outward mark is the readable surface through which concealed movement becomes known.
Stable knowledge names the inferential passage from effects to a process not directly sensed.

changed_reading.before: Only outward anatomy and visibly moving animals function as signs.
changed_reading.after: Concealed dispositions and imperceptible circulations also become signs when their effects break into visible form.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The roots at words 2, 6, 8, and 9 permit a sequence from disposition, through repeated way, to maintained communal certainty.
baseline_models.mechanism: An inwardly formed readiness becomes a persistent habit and recognizable way of moving; a people are then defined functionally by sustaining that orientation, not only demographically.

activation_trace.role: Inward disposition makes creation include a lived character as well as bodily manufacture.
Readiness or fitness supplies the potential from which a repeated way can emerge.
Persistent striving turns creaturely movement into sustained practice rather than an isolated step.
A recurring custom supplies temporal continuity to embodied conduct.
A way or disposition joins how a creature moves to the manner by which it lives.
Maintenance, care, and ongoing charge make the people a community that keeps an epistemic practice alive.
Settled knowledge is the maintained condition produced by that repeated orientation.

changed_reading.before: The ayah classifies created beings and names a believing audience.
changed_reading.after: It can also stage formation as disposition: repeated ways of moving and striving form a community able to maintain certainty.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from scattered creatures at words 4 and 6 to signs, people, and certainty at words 7 through 9 foregrounds an observer's posture.
baseline_models.mechanism: A dispersed field does not automatically signify; deliberate targeting selects marks across it, while standing and rising to the task stabilize attention long enough for doubt to clear.

activation_trace.role: Scattering makes the evidence spatially distributed and therefore something attention must gather.
Deliberately aiming at a person's mark supplies active selection rather than passive seeing.
Bodily standing supplies a stable observational posture within the moving field.
Rising with resolve makes the people participants who take up the work of reading.
Fixed knowledge is the stable result of sustained, directed attention.

changed_reading.before: The signs are self-evident objects available to any viewer.
changed_reading.after: Signhood emerges through deliberate targeting and a standing, resolved attention that gathers distributed observations into certainty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening context embeds measured bodies and hidden creaturely movement inside a larger system of directed delivery, exact ordering, alternation, revival, transformation, and moving air. The focus ayah becomes the embodied middle scale of a circulating process.

activation_trace.role: Measured formation supplies the local bodily organization nested inside the wider cycle.
Outward scattering supplies the distributive phase of the cycle.
Imperceptible circulation lets life participate in the cycle below the scale of obvious locomotion.
Directed delivery from above supplies an incoming vector rather than undirected appearance.
Exactness and secure construction strengthen the measured character of the system.
Successive alternation supplies a repeatable temporal cycle.
Rain-driven life of soil and vegetation gives a material instance of latent vitality becoming active.
Turning from state to state supplies transformation rather than a static inventory.
Wind and moving air provide a carrier that links otherwise separated sites.

structural_cues: 45:3-5 descends in scale from heavens and earth, through human creation and dispersed creatures, to alternating time, rain, revived earth, and winds.
The repeated signs-for-a-people construction places 45:4 between cosmic extent and process-rich weather rather than as an isolated biological example.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, exactness, alternation, revival, state-change, and wind; I infer that they bracket 45:4 as one circulation whose middle layer is embodied life. A live alternative is that the three sign verses simply list independent domains.

changed_reading.before: Human bodies and animals are discrete objects set beside cosmic and weather signs.
changed_reading.after: Human formation and creaturely dispersal are the embodied transfer layer within a nested system of descent, circulation, revival, and transformation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes exposure to signs from reception of them: a sequence can be heard and known while resolve, self-magnification, and ridicule block compliance. Certainty in 45:4 therefore becomes an enacted receptivity, not merely accumulated information.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate targeting of a mark makes sign reception an intentional encounter.
Rising with resolve supplies the positive response that the later refusal withholds.
Stable knowledge names reception that has passed beyond mere acoustic or propositional contact.
Following in sequence makes the signs an ordered address whose parts ask to be tracked.
Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the objective pressure of the address.
Hearing as understanding and compliance separates genuine reception from sound entering the ear.
Firm persistence supplies an active counter-posture that can hold against evidence.
Self-exalting greatness supplies the affective blockage that prevents receptive standing.
Disclosure to a knower proves that cognition alone need not govern response.
Ridicule converts a received mark into an object of dismissal.
Gentle direction toward a path gives signs a practical orientation beyond information.

structural_cues: 45:6-11 repeats the sign root through recitation, hearing, partial knowing, ridicule, covering, and guidance.
The hear-again-as-if-not-heard construction in 45:8 makes nonresponse a chosen posture rather than lack of exposure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered recitation, reality, hearing-as-compliance, stubborn resolve, knowledge, ridicule, and guidance; I map that reception pattern back onto the natural signs of 45:4. A live alternative is that this response dynamic belongs only to verbal revelation, not creaturely observation.

changed_reading.before: Certainty follows automatically from sufficient natural data.
changed_reading.after: The creaturely signs become an event of address whose force depends on a receptive, enacted posture; hearing and knowing can occur without certainty.

context_deltas.mechanism: Subjection to purpose, traversable expanse, flow, sought bounty, gathered multiplicity, and reflective turning activate the focus creatures as a distributed affordance network. Their routes and interactions make provision possible, so function and interdependence become signs.

activation_trace.role: Dispersal distributes living agents across the field in which their functions interlock.
A route along which a stream or ants run makes creaturely movement legible as channel and infrastructure.
The manifest mark lets practical effects, not only forms, carry sign value.
Making something serviceable and steering it toward a purpose supplies the network's directed utility.
Breadth and extension supply a field whose value appears through traversal.
Flowing movement aligns creaturely routes with transport through the larger field.
Gift and bounty supply provision as an output of the traversed system.
A small input whose effect becomes visible frames gratitude as noticing functional yield.
Gathering separated parts supplies the counter-motion that lets dispersed agents operate as one system.
Repeated turning of the heart mirrors the repeated tracing needed to perceive networked function.

structural_cues: 45:12 moves from a serviceable sea through vessel motion to seeking bounty and gratitude; 45:13 gathers the whole celestial-terrestrial field under the same frame.
The repeated second-person benefit language links cosmic ordering to practical human use without erasing the nonhuman agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposeful service, expanse, flow, bounty, gathering, and reflection; I infer that dispersed creatures participate as routes and agents in an affordance network. A live alternative is that the context concerns maritime resources alone and leaves the creatures as specimens.

changed_reading.before: Scattered creatures are many specimens displayed across the earth.
changed_reading.after: Their dispersal, paths, and interactions compose distributed infrastructure through which movement, provision, and human action become possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reciprocal consequence, intentional action returning to the self, a life-giving route, trace-following, and inward inclination activate the focus branches of disposition and habitual way. Creaturely embodiment becomes a model for how repeated conduct forms a moral path.

activation_trace.role: Inward nature lets human formation include the disposition from which action proceeds.
Habit and continuing custom supply the temporal mechanism by which isolated acts become character.
A creature's way or disposition joins locomotion to a lived mode of conduct.
Care and sustained charge make the people a maintained ethical formation rather than a neutral crowd.
Answering an act with its consequence supplies the feedback loop by which conduct matters.
Purposive action supplies the unit that repetition can turn into habit.
The thing's own self makes consequence reflexive rather than merely external.
An open access point to water supplies a life-bearing route through which conduct can be channeled.
Tracking one trace after another supplies the mechanics of following a path.
Inward inclination supplies a competing vector that can bend the repeated way.

structural_cues: 45:14-19 moves from a people and their recompense to act and self, then to disagreement after knowledge, a prescribed route, following, inclination, and alliance.
The singular self-accounting construction in 45:15 interrupts group labels and makes embodiment the site where effects return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies action, reflexive consequence, route, trace-following, and inclination; I map these onto the focus branches of inward nature, habit, and way. A live alternative is that 45:4 remains strictly biological and the ethical sequence only supplies a distant analogy.

changed_reading.before: Your creation refers to bodily origin, while creaturely movement is morally neutral locomotion.
changed_reading.after: Embodiment also carries dispositions and repeated paths: purposive acts return to the self and gradually make a maintained ethical way.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact people-of-certainty refrain reappears attached to inward sights, guidance, and mercy. This changes the focus signs from passive evidence presented to an already certain audience into perceptual and orienting instruments that help form that audience.

activation_trace.role: A manifest mark supplies the external object from which an inward faculty can take orientation.
Insight of the heart turns the sign from a seen item into an instrument of inward perception.
Gentle direction toward a path gives perception a practical vector.
Tender mercy makes the perceptual aid beneficent rather than merely evidentiary.
Maintenance and care make the receiving people an epistemic formation sustained by these aids.
Settled knowledge is both the audience's condition and the faculty strengthened by insight and guidance.

structural_cues: 45:20 reproduces the final two rooted terms of 45:4 in the same order while replacing signs with inward sights, guidance, and mercy.
The shift from external marks in 45:4 to perceptual language in 45:20 creates a feedback relation between object and observer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact refrain plus inward sight, direction, and mercy; I infer that these describe what the focus signs do to a receptive reader. A live alternative is that the demonstrative in 45:20 points chiefly to revealed instruction and does not transfer all three functions to natural signs.

changed_reading.before: Signs are passive objects read by people whose certainty already exists.
changed_reading.after: Creaturely signs can function as inward sight, guidance, and mercy that cultivate and maintain the very certainty able to read them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Counting, acquired action, contested equality, repeated creation-by-measure, reality, matching recompense, gain, and misplacement turn proportion into a moral question. The same measured order that shapes bodies now resists indiscriminate equivalence between unlike trajectories.

activation_trace.role: Estimation and proportion provide the focus ayah's initial grammar of measure.
Counting and reckoning convert an assumed equivalence into something subject to measure.
Acquiring an act makes each trajectory the product of embodied doing.
Equality between two things supplies the comparison that the context rejects as badly judged.
Repeated creation as measure carries the focus's proportional image into the explicit accounting frame.
Reality fixed against falsehood grounds the measure in more than arbitrary preference.
Matching an act with its consequence supplies proportional return.
Seeking and obtaining gain ties the returned measure to what each self actually acquires.
Putting something outside its proper place defines the injustice that accurate proportion avoids.

structural_cues: 45:21 asks whether contrary embodied histories can be made equal in life and death; 45:22 answers with creation, reality, recompense, acquisition, and negated injustice.
The repeated creation root at 45:22 reconnects the moral comparison directly to the focus word at 45:4.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit comparison, accounting, repeated creation, matching return, and misplacement; I infer that bodily proportion in 45:4 prefigures non-arbitrary moral differentiation. A live alternative is that creation in reality establishes purpose generally without making anatomy itself an accounting model.

changed_reading.before: Measured creation is primarily anatomical order.
changed_reading.after: Measured creation also trains recognition of fitting distinction: unlike acquired trajectories are not flattened into a false equality, and consequences remain proportionate to embodied acts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denial sequence reduces life to temporal succession and guesswork; the reply answers outward life and death with gathering, rising, and absence of doubt. The focus's dispersal is therefore no longer a final direction but one phase in a reversible temporal arc.

activation_trace.role: Scattering supplies the outward phase whose possible inverse the later gathering activates.
Creaturely stages across life and death make dispersal a temporal succession as well as a spatial event.
Resurrection and rising of the hour are latent in the people-root and supply the arc's return posture.
Fixed knowledge resists treating the visible succession of lives as the whole temporal system.
Extended time supplies the closed linear model to which the context attributes destruction.
Unsettled supposition marks that linear model as epistemically incomplete.
Joining what has been dispersed supplies the explicit inverse to broadcasting creatures.
Rising at the appointed event converts the audience-root into the arc's terminal action.
Agitated doubt supplies the state explicitly excluded from the gathering claim.

structural_cues: 45:24 orders worldly life, death, life, destruction by time, lack of knowledge, and supposition; 45:26 answers with giving life, causing death, and gathering.
The focus's outward dispersal and 45:26's inward gathering form a directional reversal even though no explicit causal connector joins them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies linear time, guesswork, life-death sequence, gathering, rising, and excluded doubt; I infer a reversible arc from the focus's scattering to later collection. A live alternative is that gathering concerns human judgment only and does not reshape the wider creaturely dispersal.

changed_reading.before: Creaturely dispersal is an open-ended multiplication of life within the present world.
changed_reading.after: Dispersal becomes one temporal phase whose hidden counter-motion is gathering; even the people of certainty carry a latent image of future rising.

context_deltas.mechanism: Communities are gathered to a register, actions are copied, and the register speaks through indicative force. This activates hidden and dispersed movement in 45:4 as trace-making activity: motion does not vanish but becomes readable record.

activation_trace.role: Spreading together with searching and uncovering makes distribution capable of yielding evidence.
Hidden circulation supplies activity whose trace can persist even when the movement itself escapes sensation.
A manifest mark is the residual surface on which prior activity becomes legible.
A community or kind gathers many individual trajectories into a collective unit of reading.
Entering a name into a register supplies the indexing of each gathered community.
Joined letters and the written object provide the durable substrate of the trace.
An indication that speaks lets the record testify through its own evidentiary arrangement.
Copying the image of one writing into another supplies faithful transfer from action to record.
Purposive acts are the moving events whose traces are transferred into the register.

structural_cues: 45:28 moves from every community to its register and what it did; 45:29 immediately makes that register speak and describes copying the actions.
The sequence converts dispersed plurality into indexed groups, then converts transient doing into durable indication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies communities, registration, speaking indication, copying, and acts; I infer that the focus's moving creatures and hidden circulations are trace-producing rather than ephemeral. A live alternative is that the record is wholly external divine documentation and says nothing about intrinsic traces in created motion.

changed_reading.before: Signs are present objects or events observed while they occur.
changed_reading.after: Dispersed motion leaves marks that can be gathered, indexed, copied, and made to testify; creaturely activity becomes a readable archive.

context_deltas.mechanism: An appointed promise is met with supposition and explicit non-certainty; concealed consequences then appear and surround, while deceptive shine delays recognition and exit is denied. The focus's hidden circulation and disclosure now model certainty as seeing a trajectory before it surfaces and closes around the actor.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure of what was held inside supplies the eventual emergence of latent consequence.
Imperceptible circulation supplies the earlier stage of a process that is real before it is visible.
A visible mark gives the anticipatory knower a present surface from which to infer the hidden trajectory.
Knowledge fixed beyond doubt allows commitment before consequence becomes overwhelming appearance.
A promise bounded by an appointed time supplies a future event already structured in the present.
Doubtful supposition supplies the inadequate posture toward that structured future.
The explicit absence of settled knowledge creates the direct negative mirror of 45:4.
Emergence into view supplies the late visible phase of formerly latent acts.
Descending harm that encircles supplies the closed spatial consequence of the hidden trajectory.
Deceptive shine that does not endure explains how immediate appearance can conceal a trajectory's end.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies an emergence image whose negation marks irreversibility.

structural_cues: 45:32 explicitly opposes repeated supposition to settled certainty; 45:33 then shifts from claims about the future to consequences becoming visible and enclosing.
The uncitable root ع ت ب at 45:35 word 16 is retained only as the final structural element after the negated خروج; no branch identity is assigned to it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, supposition, negated certainty, appearance, encirclement, deceptive shine, and negated emergence; I infer a latent-to-manifest trajectory that certainty can read early. A live alternative is that the signs warn propositionally without sharing the material mechanism of hidden creaturely circulation.

changed_reading.before: Certainty confirms signs once their meaning is already visible.
changed_reading.after: Certainty is anticipatory perception: it reads present marks as the early surface of hidden trajectories before their consequences emerge and become enclosing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing praise, repeated lordship over the cosmic domains, cohesion, and exactness return the sign sequence to formed existence. Completed creaturely form is not only evidence of order but a praiseworthy enactment of sustaining governance.

activation_trace.role: Completed and balanced configuration supplies the formed existence evaluated at the close.
The manifest mark allows formed existence itself to bear evaluative force.
Being found praiseworthy turns coherent existence into more than neutral evidence.
Nurturing, repairing, and bringing to completion supply the sustaining agency behind formed life.
Cohesion and firmness supply material integrity to the closing evaluation of order.
Exact, secure making closes the loop back to measured and completed creation.

structural_cues: 45:36-37 repeats heavens and earth from the opening sign sequence and closes them with praise, lordship, greatness, strength, and wisdom.
The end of the surah returns from judgment scenes to the same cosmic domains that framed 45:4, producing a scale closure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies praiseworthiness, sustaining completion, cohesion, and exactness; I infer that the focus's completed forms perform praise through their coherence. A live alternative is that the final praise is an independent doxology rather than a changed reading of creaturely form.

changed_reading.before: Well-formed creatures are neutral evidence from which an observer infers order.
changed_reading.after: Their completed, sustained coherence can itself be carried as praiseworthy performance, not only as proof presented to an external observer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from biological dispersal into discourse and uses a fabrication branch under the focus creation-root. It remains anchored because fabrication, disclosure, and gossip are all packet branches attached to three successive focus roots, while the context adds lying and deceptive appearance. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary lexical activation, never as the direct translation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus roots at words 2, 4, and 6 can align fabricated material, disclosure of what was hidden, and gossip that moves among people.

activation_trace.role: Fabricated speech supplies socially manufactured content in place of bodily manufacture.
Disclosing inner news or secrets supplies the broadcast stage of social transmission.
Gossip creeping between people supplies the low-visibility carrier through a social body.
Visible marks make the effects of an otherwise hidden transmission ecology diagnosable.
A lie turned away from truth supplies the context's explicit species of manufactured content.
Deceptive shine that fails to endure explains why transmitted fabrications can initially attract belief.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns nonhuman creatures physically scattered through space.
changed_reading.after: A secondary social reading sees constructed claims, disclosed inner material, and gossip crawling through a population, with their effects becoming diagnostic signs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a water-holding depression under the creation-root and a stream-path under the creature-root. It remains visibly anchored in focus words 2, 4, and 6, and the adjacent context supplies delivered rain, rain-as-provision, revived land, and flow. Downstream prose should qualify it as a material systems analogy, not replace creation or creature with basin or channel.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's formation, dispersal, and creature roots can jointly image holding sites and paths through which a distributed flow moves.

activation_trace.role: A hollow or well that retains water turns created form into temporary storage capacity.
Scattering supplies the distribution of many holding and transfer sites.
The running-place of a stream or ants supplies a conduit joining distributed sites.
Delivery downward supplies the incoming water to the catchment system.
Rain descending as provision gives the distributed flow a life-supporting function.
Land revived through rain supplies the visible output of storage and transfer.
Flow and streaming provide the motion that connects catchment, conduit, and use.

changed_reading.before: Created bodies and creatures are objects placed within an external water cycle.
changed_reading.after: Created forms can be carried as temporary catchments and creaturely routes as conduits through which provision circulates across a living landscape.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the audience noun through bodily standing, stoppage, and future rising, then contrasts it with creaturely motion and later kneeling. It remains anchored in the focus's movement, people, and certainty roots and gains a direct posture reversal at 45:27-28. Downstream prose should mark it as a spatial-epistemic metaphor, not redefine the ordinary audience noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places scattered creeping motion before a people-root whose inventory includes standing, stoppage, and resurrection, followed by fixed knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Scattering supplies a field with no single stable center.
Light ground movement makes pervasive mobility the field's dominant posture.
Bodily standing supplies a stable counter-posture within distributed movement.
Stopping or becoming still intensifies the contrast between observer stability and creaturely motion.
Fixed knowledge gives the bodily stability an epistemic analogue.
The hour's rising converts stable posture into eschatological activation.
Kneeling on the knees supplies the later inversion of confident standing.

changed_reading.before: A people of certainty is simply the demographic audience for moving-life signs.
changed_reading.after: The phrase can additionally image an epistemic posture: standing stably inside pervasive motion, before the later hour converts standing into rising and communities into kneeling.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates worn cloth under the same focus root normally carried as formation and combines it with hidden circulation and extended time. It remains anchored in focus words 2 and 6, while death, duration, and succession provide a coherent temporal pressure. Downstream prose should render it only as a material analogy of aging and attrition, never translate creation as worn fabric.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus creation-root can hold both completed form and a surface worn through use, while the creature-root can hold unseen circulation and persistent striving.

activation_trace.role: Cloth worn until its nap disappears supplies a material image of formed surfaces altered by use.
Unseen circulation of decay supplies attrition that proceeds below sensory notice.
Persistent ongoing effort supplies the repeated use through which a form wears.
Extended duration gives hidden attrition enough time to alter completed form.
Loss of force and life supplies the terminal limit of bodily wearing.
Successive replacement supplies continuity across forms even as each individual surface wears away.

changed_reading.before: Creation names a completed form, and creaturely motion displays its vitality.
changed_reading.after: Completed form also bears hidden wear: persistent living motion consumes and alters its own surface while succession carries the pattern onward.

strongest_changes: The opening circulation recast 45:4 as the embodied middle scale of delivery, alternation, revival, transformation, and wind.
The exact refrain at 45:20 changed signs from passive evidence into inward sight, guidance, and mercy that can cultivate certainty.
The life-death and gathering sequence reversed outward dispersal, while the register sequence made transient movement into durable testimony.
The late movement from explicit non-certainty to appearance and encirclement changed certainty into anticipatory perception of hidden trajectories.
The ethical sequence activated inward disposition, habit, route, and trace-following without canceling the biological reading.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots supported several mechanisms at once: measured form, spatial dispersal, hidden circulation, embodied habit, deliberate attention, and stable knowledge. Context repeatedly changed what a sign does, from patterned object to circulating process, practical affordance, perceptual instrument, moral measure, record, and early warning, while the branch-distant social, hydrological, posture, and wear readings remained containable rather than disposable.
remaining_uncertainties: The inward sight, guidance, and mercy of 45:20 may primarily describe revealed instruction rather than transfer fully to the natural signs of 45:4.
The gathering and recording mechanisms may concern human accountability specifically rather than every creature included in the focus dispersal.
The moral-disposition model may overextend the inward-nature and habitual-way branches beyond the focus ayah's dominant biological construction.
The social transmission, catchment, posture, and wear activations need explicit qualification so branch images do not become lexical replacements.
